description: This file defines the PerformancePluginConfiguration class, which implements plugin configuration for the Performance plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It registers various performance-related services into the dependency injection container during initialization.

classes.name: PerformancePluginConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring performance plugin services, registering them into the dependency injection container during plugin initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering performance-related services into the container.
